Free hot water in summer*
3× more efficient in spring, autumn and winter

In summer, the heat the AC gives off is recovered for free hot water.

Washing, showers and cleaning: hot water whenever you want it, in every season.

s18.title: ORVIBO Integrated HVAC W180 specifications
note.summer: *In summer, when cooling recovers enough heat, hot water counts as zero energy, leaving out the recovery pump: it draws 100 W, so 24 hours of running use 2.4 kWh. If your air conditioning does not recover enough heat, the unit heats water as a heat-pump water heater, which is not recovered heat. The hot water cost leaves out the zero-cold-water mode: with it on, the water left cooling in the pipes is heated again, which costs extra.
note.zeroCold: *Smart zero cold water: needs the zero-cold-water option, bought separately, with zero-cold-water mode on.
note.steadyHot: *Steady 45 °C hot water: needs the thermostatic valve option, bought separately.
note.lab: *Data from ORVIBO's lab. Actual savings vary with your habits, local electricity prices, the climate and the home's insulation.
note.size: *Calculated by ORVIBO's lab: the ORVIBO Integrated HVAC W180 takes up 75% less volume than a conventional system (a combined central AC and floor heating unit + a heat-pump water heater).
note.tenYear: *10-year warranty, far beyond the national standard: the main unit (excluding parts) has a 10-year warranty, that is the standard 6 years plus a free 4-year extension, given only on orders placed during the promotion.
note.standard: *The industry's highest standard: compared with brands in the industry, which usually give 3–⁠6 years of warranty.
